## Summary

Describe the problem and the approach. Link any related issue.

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results; note untested platforms and manual
database checks separately.

## Compatibility and security

Mention changes to saved profiles, prompts, credentials, remote commands, or
database behavior. Use only sanitized output and screenshots.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused, and behavior changes have regression coverage.
- [ ] Frontend tests/build and default Rust tests pass, or failures are explained.
- [ ] No real credentials, private infrastructure details, or user data are included.
- [ ] Documentation and third-party notices are updated where needed.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under Apache-2.0.
